description_html:
This outstanding one-bedroom duplex retains many original features, including the Brooke Marine kitchen with its stainless steel hob, worktop and basin. Entry is on the third floor and comprises an entrance hall leading to the bathroom and a double bedroom with fitted cupboard. An original mahogany staircase rises to a generous reception room, illuminated by a full-height window and sliding door opening onto a south-facing balcony. Type M2A.

The covered, south facing terrace has ample space for a table and chairs, as well as planting, with views over the landscaped podium.
Ben Jonson House was completed in 1973, with 204 flats is the longest terrace block on the estate, with three lifts which go to street level and the car park with a 24 hour car park attendant.

Situated on the northern side of the estate Ben Jonson House is located close to Whitecross Street with a full size Waitrose supermarket, weekday food market and a selection of restaurants.


Ben Jonson House was named after the actor and playwright who wrote Bartholomew Fair etc and lived for some years in the parish of Cripplegate.

The property is within walking distance of Moorgate, Liverpool Street, Barbican and Farringdon stations, offering connections to the Elizabeth Line, Circle, District, and Hammersmith & City lines, as well as mainline services.

Tenure: Leasehold Lease Years Remaining: 80
Service Charge: £6,052 (Yearly)
Annual Ground Rent: £10
Council Tax Band: E
